---
name: Native Mac issue
about: Reproduce a native Mac build or gameplay problem
---

## Revision and hardware
Source commit, macOS version, Mac model, memory, display/settings.

## What happened
Expected behavior, actual behavior, smallest reproduction.

## Evidence
Label build-only / synthetic / headless / gameplay / multiplayer. Include a short relevant log excerpt with personal paths removed. Do not upload game/mod data, private saves, credentials or crash dumps without reviewing their contents.
